eligible_conditions: Adolescents and adults aged 15-65 without regard to perceived risk (annual screening)
Adolescents younger than 15 and adults older than 65 at increased risk for HIV infection (annual screening)
Pregnant Medicare beneficiaries (up to three screenings: at diagnosis of pregnancy, third trimester, and at labor)
exclusions: Screenings for individuals outside the specified age ranges without increased risk
More than one annual screening for non-pregnant beneficiaries unless at increased risk
More than three screenings for pregnant beneficiaries
Screenings not ordered by a physician or practitioner within a healthcare setting
Screenings not performed by an eligible Medicare provider
Tests not FDA-approved or not compliant with CLIA regulations

citations.source: NCD 210.7 - Screening for Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) Infection
USPSTF Grade A Recommendation for HIV Screening
